declarations.docstring: An auxiliary type depending on a free algebra and a family of its elements.
The images of the generators algebraically generate the enclosing auxiliary algebra.
A map from generators whose free extension kills every specified element induces a unique algebra homomorphism from the auxiliary algebra.
For finite index types, the auxiliary type is equal to the quotient by the ring congruence generated by the specified range.
The canonical map from the generator type into the auxiliary type.
The canonical generator map agrees with the auxiliary algebra homomorphism applied to the free-algebra inclusion.
Algebra homomorphisms out of the auxiliary algebra are equal when they agree on generators.
Constructs an algebra homomorphism from the auxiliary algebra when the proposed generator values annihilate the specified elements.
The lifted homomorphism takes each canonical generator to its prescribed value.
Composing the lift with the auxiliary algebra homomorphism agrees with the free-algebra lift.
The free-algebra lift determined by an algebra homomorphism on the auxiliary algebra vanishes on every specified element.
The canonical algebra homomorphism from the free algebra to the auxiliary algebra.
Each specified element maps to zero under the auxiliary algebra homomorphism.
The auxiliary algebra homomorphism from the free algebra is surjective.
A free-algebra lift killing the relations has a kernel containing their generated ring congruence.
The ring congruence on a free algebra generated by a family of relations.
